statement: A verifier rejection passed to land records its categorized findings and reopens the Quest automatically; the next continue with a summary begins and captures the replacement attempt without manual oracle edits or evidence ingestion; unchanged or narrower scope reauthorization is automatic; source-digest preflight results are reused; deterministic inventories refresh only once immediately before the final landing commit; and land mints an immutable review id only after the candidate passes the cheap structural and changed-path preflight.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The routine correction path must require only land, continue with a summary, and land again; component commands remain diagnostic only.
Automation may remove ceremony but must not weaken immutable review identity, categorized rejection evidence, source-epoch admission, exact aggregate approval, or scope-clean commit ownership.
